method: Every non-reprint card from Lorwyn Eclipsed through Reality Fracture (and their Commander decks) was checked against the 20 most recently updated Bracket 2-3 Goro-Goro decks on Moxfield and EDHREC's Goro-Goro pages, then filtered for creatures that attack the turn they enter (haste, ninjutsu, sneak). Game Changers excluded.
summary: Goro-Goro makes a 5/5 Dragon when creatures that entered this turn connect. Haste for the team (Samut) and the Turtles sneak cards, which put creatures in attacking, are the clear upgrades. The badge on each card counts the sources that include it; "Claude's pick" means no list runs it yet.

picks.name: Samut, Hazoret's Champion
picks.why: Two mana: all your creatures have haste. Every creature you cast can attack the turn it enters, which is exactly what makes Goro-Goro make Dragons.

sources.label: Moxfield: 8 of 20 recent Bracket 2-3 Goro-Goro lists

picks.cutWhy: Samut gives the whole team haste instead of one flyer
